answer: Make identity expensive to fake and cheap to prove: require each agent to stake a small deposit that grows with the value it handles, so spinning up thousands of fake accounts becomes a real cost. Reputation acts like a mirror — every deal reflects past behaviour, visible to peers before they trust you. At the zenith of the system, only agents with a verifiable track record reach the best work, while new identities enter through a narrow inlet with low limits until they prove themselves.
